idea-plugin.name: Inline Reading Mode
idea-plugin.description:
Read code without jumping between files. Put the caret on a method call and press Alt+,: the callee's body appears inline below the call, read-only and syntax-highlighted. It works recursively — expand calls inside the expanded body too — and the file you are in stays fully editable. Collapse with the same shortcut, Esc, or by clicking the frame header. Interface and abstract calls inline the only implementation or let you pick one; library calls show attached sources or the decompiled body.

Then pick the variables you care about and read only the code that touches them:

  • Alt+. — track the parameter or local variable at the caret; every line that touches it gets its own color.
  • Alt+; — search and manage tracked symbols: parameters, locals and fields of the current method.
  • Alt+' — follow the value, not the name: everything derived from a tracked variable (assignments, call arguments, returns) and everything written into it.
  • Alt+Shift+; — fold every line that touches no tracked symbol, so a 400-line method shrinks to the lines that matter.

A tracked variable passed as an argument is tracked as the parameter inside the inlined frame, so one value can be followed through the whole call chain.

Java only. Made by NEEX.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 0.1.0 — first release: inline expansion (recursive, implementation picker, library sources), focus tracking, value flow, fold to focus, tracking into inlined frames.
